title: Qingdao welcomes visitors with sun, sand, and sea
text:
Qingdao welcomes visitors with sun, sand, and sea
Silver Beach in the Qingdao West Coast New Area is now drawing visitors for early summer leisure breaks. Tourists stroll along the sandy shore or dip their feet in the shallow water, enjoying the cool sea breeze and beautiful coastal scenery.
Stretching over 2,000 meters in a crescent shape, the beach is a natural, free-open seawater bathing area. Its fine, even sand glimmers silver under the sun, giving the beach its name. Facing the Yellow Sea to the south and backed by a black pine forest, Silver Beach offers a stunning blend of sun, sea, sand, and woodland.
Visitors enjoy a relaxing walk along the crescent‑shaped Silver Beach in Qingdao West Coast New Area. [Photo/IC]
With its fine, even sand glistening like silver under the sun, Silver Beach resembles a silver plate inlaid on blue silk. [Photo/IC]
The fine, silver-glittering sand and clear shallow waters make Silver Beach a perfect summer getaway. [Photo/IC]
